subject: RFI: bakeoff pass/fail metrics and control plan for inference endpoints
messages:
From: Samuel Ortiz <s.ortiz@northbridge.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2027 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: RFI: performance acceptance criteria for inference endpoints

Hi Vivek / Ben,

Thanks for the initial call earlier this week. Procurement at Northbridge has asked us to capture a clear pass/fail matrix for the upcoming bakeoff so we can include it in the RFP package. High level asks:

- A concise list of latency/throughput metrics to be validated (p50/p90/p99, cold start definitions).
- Minimum acceptable pass/fail thresholds per metric for our SLA discussion.
- Test harness requirements we (Northbridge) need to provide vs what Redwood will run.
- Any special considerations for mixed-use (chat + embed + reranking) endpoints.

I attached a sample traffic profile that represents our expected QPS mix. Can you confirm whether Redwood can (a) run the bakeoff in your lab, (b) provide a small subset of live read-only endpoints for verification, or (c) if we need to ship data and run in our environment?

We'd like a formal response we can include with the RFP by Monday 22-Nov.

Thanks,
Sam
Samuel Ortiz
Senior Procurement Manager, Northbridge AI
[Attachment: northbridge-traffic-profile.json (application/json)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Samuel Ortiz <s.ortiz@northbridge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFI: performance acceptance criteria for inference endpoints

Sam —

Thanks for the detailed ask and the traffic profile, that helps a lot. Below is a proposed bakeoff acceptance matrix and the control plan. I'm happy to walk through this on a brief call if you want.

Proposed pass/fail metrics (per endpoint type):
- Latency (inference-only, cold-start excluded): p50 <= 45ms, p90 <= 120ms, p99 <= 350ms.
- Cold start (first request after idle > 5m): p95 <= 1.5s for provisioned endpoints; if using on-demand, flag as not applicable unless explicitly tested.
- Throughput: sustained QPS for target configuration with <= 2x allocated headroom; report mean sustained QPS and saturation QPS.
- Error rate: overall 5xx < 0.1% during steady-state load.
- Consistency: semantic quality regressions <= 2% on your eval set (we'll run the same eval prompts).

Pass/fail rules (high level):
1) Pass if all latency and error thresholds are met during a 30-minute sustained run at your expected peak QPS, and quality regressions are within tolerance.
2) If p99 breaches but p50/p90 meet targets, outcome = conditional pass; Redwood to provide mitigation (e.g., increased provisioned replicas or quantization variant) and re-run.
3) If error rate >= 0.1% or sustained throughput is < 75% of expected QPS, fail.

Control plan / responsibilities:
- Redwood will: provide the test harness (k6 + custom tokenized payload driver), host-side observability (token-level latency, model metrics), and run up to three separate bakeoff windows in our lab. We will supply an instrumentation bundle and the test scripts.
- Northbridge will: provide the canonical prompt/eval sets for quality checks, the traffic profile (you already provided), and optional secure data access if you want in-environment runs.
- If you require on-prem execution, Redwood can provide a containerized harness and step-by-step runbook; this will be subject to a short work order.

Attachments we will share with the RFP:
- redwood-bakeoff-passfail-matrix.xlsx (detailed thresholds + test steps)
- redwood-sla-runbook-v2.pdf (lab requirements & instrumentation)

Proposed schedule: initial run in Redwood lab the week of Nov 29, two re-runs (tuning + verification) the following week. If you need the formal response by 22-Nov, I can provide the initial matrix now and attach the spreadsheets in this thread.

Would you like us to sign an NDA or run the lab under a temporary connectivity agreement?

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-bakeoff-passfail-matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samuel Ortiz <s.ortiz@northbridge.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 21 Nov 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFI: performance acceptance criteria for inference endpoints

Sam — quick operational notes to complement Vivek's response.

- Test harness: we use k6 for QPS shaping and a custom token-level driver to simulate realistic prompt lengths and KV cache behavior. The driver replays your provided message mix (chat / embed / rerank) and annotates tokens for latency breakdowns.
- Warmup policy: 5 minutes of progressive ramp + 10 minutes steady-state prior to recording metrics; we explicitly exclude initial warmup from the 30-minute steady-state run.
- Replica scaling: runs include autoscaler off (fixed replica count) and autoscaler on (to verify graceful degradation). We'll capture both.
- Observability artifacts we will deliver: per-token latency histograms, server-side GPU utilization traces, batch size distribution, and a runbook with exact command lines to reproduce.

Kimberly — tagging you to confirm whether the team can provide a small dedicated lab endpoint for Northbridge for an hour-long verification test before the final run. If not, we'll run in our staging cluster behind isolation.

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-sla-runbook-v2.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Samuel Ortiz <s.ortiz@northbridge.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 07:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFI: performance acceptance criteria for inference endpoints

Thanks Vivek/Ben — this is exactly the level of detail our procurement team needed. A few clarifying points from our side:

- For p99 target, can you provide historical lab evidence for comparable models and config (a single-run CSV or plot would be sufficient)?
- For the quality check, we will share a 200-sample eval set. Will Redwood run a semantic-similarity evaluation and return delta scores?
- For the "conditional pass" mitigation, please confirm SLA on turnaround for a re-run (we expect <= 3 business days for reconfiguration + verification).

We can provide the eval set by EOD Monday. If you can confirm the evidence and turnaround guarantees, we'll include your response in the RFP bundle and circulate to legal for a short bakeoff MSA.

Best,
Sam
[Attachment: northbridge-eval-sample-200.json (application/json)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Samuel Ortiz <s.ortiz@northbridge.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 09:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: RFI: performance acceptance criteria for inference endpoints

Sam — appreciate the quick turnaround. Answers inline: 

- Historical evidence: yes — we'll attach an anonymized CSV of three representative lab runs (same model family, similar sequence lengths) showing p50/p90/p99 and batch distribution. We'll redact customer IDs.
- Quality evaluation: we will run your 200-sample eval with our standard semantic-similarity pipeline (BERTScore + human spot-check for edge cases) and report delta against your baseline.
- Conditional pass turnaround: Redwood commits to a 3 business day re-run SLA for configuration changes that are within our standard matrix. Major infrastructure changes may require longer; we'll call that out if needed.

Next steps:
1) We'll upload the anonymized run CSV and the bakeoff artifacts to the Drive folder and share the link by EOD today.
2) Please confirm whether you want the lab run (Redwood-hosted) or the in-environment run; if lab-hosted, we will schedule an initial 60-minute verification window on Nov 29 morning PST.
3) Please countersign the temporary bakeoff MSA (DocuSign link below) so we can schedule lab resources.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/s/ND-8893-redwood-bakeoff-agreement
Drive (artifacts will be uploaded here): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1zB-Redwood-Bakeoff

I'll loop in Solutions Ops to reserve rack time pending your confirmation.

— Vivek
